from collections import Counter
def border_fill(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    t,l,b,r=min(i for i,_ in cells),min(j for _,j in cells),max(i for i,_ in cells),max(j for _,j in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(t,b+1):
        for j in range(l,r+1):
            if (i in (t,b) or j in (l,r)) and g[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=2
    return out
